intro.text:
This program is for anyone who wants to lose fat for good — without hopping between fad diets. We pair coached conditioning with a nutrition approach built around your real schedule, then track the numbers that matter so progress is steady and repeatable.

Most members see meaningful changes within the first 6–8 weeks and, more importantly, learn the habits to maintain them.
